GenTact Toolbox

A Procedural Whole-Body Sensor Design Pipeline

The GenTact Toolbox provides computational tools for creating versatile whole-body tactile skins tailored to both robot shape and application.

View on GitHub View Premade STLs (Coming Soon) Purchase Electronics (Coming Soon)

Publications

GenTact Toolbox: A Computational Design Pipeline
ICRA 2025
RC-Coupling

A computational pipeline for creating versatile whole-body tactile skins through procedural mesh generation, task-driven simulation, and multi-material 3D printing.

Learn more
Form-Fitting, Large-Area Sensor Mounting for Obstacle Detection
Humanoids ConRich Workshop 2025
Time-of-Flight

Extends GenTact with a form-fitting, large-area sensor mounting solution for time-of-flight sensors.

Learn more
Recently accepted to ICRA 2026
GenTact-Prox: Tactile and Proximity Sensing
ICRA 2026
Self-Capacitive

Extends GenTact with capacitive sensing for proximity detection (up to 18 cm) and contact anticipation.

Learn more
